open_points.subject: personal-data classification of project display names
open_points.text: “Personal data — the customer's contact and fiscal data and the object's address and identifying characteristics are `personal_data`” conflicts with R0-82: “the display name is held as `personal_data`”
open_points.question: Is a project's display name explicitly part of the `personal_data` class at this trust boundary?
options: Add project display names to the stated personal-data set
Treat display names as another disclosure class despite R0-82
open_points.default_guess: Classify every project display name as `personal_data`.

open_points.subject: customer erasure and fiscal data
open_points.text: “erase a customer's contact data” says “The Customer keeps only its identity and the fact that it was erased; name, phone, e-mail and language are gone” while customers now also hold tax id and legal name
open_points.question: When this action erases a Customer, are tax id and legal name erased too, or do they remain stored?
options: Erase contact and fiscal data, leaving only identity and the erased fact
Erase only name, phone, e-mail and language while retaining fiscal data
Provide a separate fiscal-data erasure action
open_points.default_guess: Erase both contact and fiscal data so that only identity and the erased fact remain.

open_points.subject: renaming projects during import
open_points.text: The import accepts projects “each with a new display name and alias when the owner gives them”; R0-85 says the owner “may give each a new display name”, but R0-82 says projects imported under a person's name “are renamed” in the import
open_points.question: Must every imported project receive a replacement display name, or may its legacy display name be retained, including one containing a person's name?
options: Require a new display name for every imported project
Require a new display name only when the legacy name identifies a person, relying on the owner to declare that
open_points.default_guess: Require a new display name for every imported project; keep the alias optional.

open_points.subject: legacy artifact pointers during import
open_points.text: The import keeps projects “with their customers, objects, rooms and pointers (ids kept)” while R0-33 accepts only artifact types declared by the specification and owned by their declared service
open_points.question: What happens if an imported pointer has an undeclared artifact type or names an owner service different from the specification's owner for that type?
options: Import the pointer unchanged as historical data but prohibit new publication for its type
Drop or remap the pointer during the checked import mapping
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the whole import until every pointer conforms to the declared vocabulary and ownership.

open_points.subject: audit-log coverage
open_points.text: Registry records “only significant changes of state: changes to projects and customer records, granting and revoking an agent session's projects, restricting processing and lifting it, and erasures and anonymisations”
open_points.question: Which changed actions count as audited “changes to projects”: room creation, artifact publication or withdrawal, import, archiving, session registration, access requests and answers, and active-project changes?
options: Declare an exact operation-by-operation audit list
Audit only the explicitly named record and grant/revocation changes
open_points.default_guess: Audit every accepted state-changing operation and explicitly enumerate them.

open_points.subject: audit erasure cutoff
open_points.text: “erase audit entries before a date” has no failure and promises both that “every entry older than the date” is gone and that the erasure creates a new audit entry
open_points.question: May the owner give a future cutoff date, which would make the newly created erasure entry itself older than the cutoff, and what is the observable failure for an invalid cutoff?
options: Refuse a cutoff later than today
Allow a future cutoff but exempt the new erasure entry
Allow a future cutoff and immediately erase the new entry
open_points.default_guess: Refuse a cutoff later than today without changing the log.
